pacific-islands.title: Ol Aelan blong Pasifik
pacific-islands.description: Papua Niugini, Fiji, Solomon Aelan, Vanuatu, Niu Kaledonia, Palau, Maekronesia, Masol Aelan, Nauru, Tuvalu mo Gilbet Aelan blong Kiribati — Pot Mosbi, Suva, Nadi, Honiara, Pot Vila, Numea mo Majuro.

south-central-us.title: Saot Senta blong Yunaeted Stet
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi mo Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson mo Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa mo Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, Amerikan Samoa, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau mo Wallis mo Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi mo Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila mo ol aelan blong Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam mo Not Mariana Aelan
mariana-islands.description: Guam mo Not Mariana Aelan — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian mo Rota.

greenland.title: Grinlan
greenland.description: Grinlan — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq mo Tasiilaq; bigfala ae blong ston, Ilulissat Icefjord mo ol fjord long saot.

bermuda.title: Bemuda
bermuda.description: Bemuda — Hamilton, St. George’s mo Royal Naval Dockyard, ol pares blong aelan mo ol sanbij blong hem we oli gat pink san.

belarus.title: Belarus
belarus.description: Belarus — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno mo Brest; bus blong Belovezhskaya Pushcha mo ol swamp blong Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Ol Aelan blong Jenel
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark mo Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port mo Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Faroe Aelan
faroe-islands.description: Faroe Aelan — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík mo ol eitin aelan, ol vilej, ol tanel mo ol bigfala klif blong solwota blong olgeta.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard mo Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg mo Ny-Ålesund; ol glasia mo ol fjord blong Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo mo Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria mo Tri Siti.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagaska mo ol Aelan blong Indian Osen
madagascar-islands.description: Madagaska, Komoros, Mayotte, Réunion, Morisos mo Seisel — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis mo Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Sudan — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid mo Nyala; ples we Blu Nael mo Waet Nael i joen, mo ol piramid blong Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Cabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Cabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria mo ol ten aelan, stat long Santo Antão go kasem Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé mo Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé mo Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António mo ol bus mo sanbij blong tufala aelan.

saint-helena.title: Sen Helena, Asensen mo Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Sen Helena, Asensen Aelan mo Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown mo Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Banglades
bangladesh.description: Banglades — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet mo Cox’s Bazar; Sundarbans mo delta blong Ganges–Brahmaputra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka mo Maldives
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka mo Maldives — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura mo Malé; ol hil kantri, Sigiriya mo ol atol.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Vietnam — Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh Siti, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An mo Can Tho; Ha Long Bei mo Mekong Delta.

philippines.title: Filipin
philippines.description: Filipin — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio mo Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao mo Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonesia mo Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: Indonesia mo Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar mo Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi mo Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malaysia, Singapoa mo Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malaysia, Singapoa mo Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapoa, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching mo Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine mo Inle Lek; vali blong Irrawaddy mo ol hil blong Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Kambodia mo Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Kambodia mo Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap mo Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang mo Pakse; Mekong mo Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Kolombia
colombia.description: Kolombia — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena mo Bucaramanga; ol Andes, kos blong Karibian mo Amazon.

venezuela.title: Venezuela
venezuela.description: Venezuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida mo Ciudad Bolívar; Angel Wotafol, Orinoco mo Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos mo Puno; Machu Picchu, Lek Titicaca mo Sacred Valley.

ecuador.title: Ekwador
ecuador.description: Ekwador — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta mo Baños; Rod blong ol Volkeno, Amazon mo ol Galápagos Aelan.

bolivia.title: Bolivia
bolivia.description: Bolivia — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre mo Potosí; Lek Titicaca mo Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Jile
chile.description: Jile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena mo Punta Arenas; Atacama, Lek Distrik, Patagonia mo Ista Aelan.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paraguay mo Uruguay
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paraguay mo Uruguay — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este mo Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Ol Guiana
guianas.description: Guyana, Suriname mo Franis Guiana — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne mo Kourou; Kaieteur Wotafol mo bus blong Guiana Shield.

falklands.title: Falklan Aelan
falklands.description: Falklan Aelan — Stanley, Goose Green mo ol aelan blong Is Falklan mo Wes Falklan.

australia.title: Ostrelia
australia.description: Ostrelia — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin mo Canberra; Great Barrier Reef, Uluru mo Outback.

new-zealand.title: Niu Silan
new-zealand.description: Niu Silan — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin mo Queenstown; Southern Alps, Fiordland mo Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George mo Whistler; Coast Mountains, Vancouver Aelan mo Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Ol Prairie blong Kanada
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan mo Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina mo Banff; ol Rocky Mountains, ol prairie mo Churchill long Hudson Bei.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston mo Thunder Bay; Niagara Wotafol, ol Great Lakes mo Algonquin Park.

quebec.title: Quebec
quebec.description: Quebec — Montréal, Quebec Siti, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke mo Saguenay; St. Lawrence Reva, ol Laurentians mo Gaspé Peninsula.

atlantic-canada.title: Atlantik Kanada
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Aelan mo Newfoundland mo Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton mo Charlottetown; Cabot Trail mo Bei blong Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Not Kanada
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Northwest Territories mo Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City mo Inuvik; Arctic Archipelago mo Mackenzie Reva.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong mo Macau
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong mo Macau — Hong Kong Aelan, Kowloon, New Territories, Lantau mo Macau Peninsula, Taipa mo Coloane.
